# SlackVault — Documentation Index

> SlackVault is a zero-cost Slack backup and archive platform. It connects a Slack
> workspace through OAuth, syncs messages, channels, threads, files, and the user
> directory through a Manifest V3 browser extension, and stores messages in
> the user's own Firebase free tier. File copies, when switched on, sit at a public,
> hard-to-guess link on FilesHub, not in the user's storage. SlackVault is not affiliated
> with or endorsed by Slack. A web app then lets users browse, full-text
> search, and export their archived Slack history. Author: Ahsan Mahmood (https://aoneahsan.com).

## About

SlackVault runs on a zero-server architecture: the browser extension performs the sync
locally, a Cloudflare Worker handles only the Slack OAuth code exchange and token refresh,
the website is statically hosted, and archived messages land in the user's own Firebase
Firestore (free tier). The Slack OAuth scopes are strictly
read-only — SlackVault cannot post or modify anything in a workspace. Product site:
https://slackvault.aoneahsan.com.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec — a structured index for
large language models.

## White-label & licensing

A business can run SlackVault under its own name on its own domain; we host and update it. The web app is offered
today. Prices are on https://slackvault.aoneahsan.com/white-label/pricing, read from our licensing service.

- [White-label and licensing](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label): what a licence is, and a source buyout.
- [What a white-label licence delivers](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/what-you-get): the web group, and why mobile and the extension are not offered yet.
- [Setting up a white-label copy](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/setup-timeline): domain, branding, Slack app registration, deploy.
- [Updates and renewals](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/updates-and-renewals): included months and renewals.
- [Verify a SlackVault licence](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/verify-a-licence): by key or domain; the licence file.
- [White-label questions](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/white-label/faq)

## Moving to SlackVault

- [All comparisons](https://slackvault-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare): guides for moving from Slack's own export, backup tools and other chat apps, with dated sources.

## Notes

- Zero-cost: Firebase free tier (1 GiB / 50K reads-per-day / 20K writes-per-day), Cloudflare Workers free tier, and client-side processing.
- Privacy: Slack messages stay in user-controlled storage; file copies, when switched on, are at a public link on FilesHub; message content is never used for analytics; Slack scopes are read-only.
